ComputedSpec.description:
Specification for a computed parameter.

Identifies which hydro-indexed quantity to derive and from which plant.

hydro_id.description: Hydro plant identifier. Must match an `id` in `hydros.json`.

tag.description:
Which quantity to derive. One of: `equivalent_productivity`,
`accumulated_productivity`, `reference_volume`, `reference_turbine`,
`min_storage`, `max_storage`, `specific_productivity`.

ScalarParameterEntry.description:
One scalar parameter entry. The `kind` field discriminates between the
four payload shapes.

oneOf.description: Constant parameter — one value applied to every stage.

id.description: Unique parameter identifier (int32). Must be unique across all entries.

name.description:
Unique parameter name. Must be non-empty and have no leading or
trailing whitespace.

value.description: The constant value applied to all stages. Must be finite.

oneOf.description:
Per-stage parameter — one value per study stage.

The `values` array contains `[stage_id, value]` pairs. The `stage_id`
integers must form a contiguous range starting at 0 (i.e. [0, 1, 2, …,
N-1]). Gaps, duplicates, and non-zero starts are all rejected.

id.description: Unique parameter identifier (int32). Must be unique across all entries.

name.description:
Unique parameter name. Must be non-empty and have no leading or
trailing whitespace.

values.description:
Array of [stage_id, value] pairs. Must be non-empty. stage_id values
must be contiguous from 0. All values must be finite.

items.description: Finite numeric value for this stage.

oneOf.description:
Seasonal parameter — one value per season index.

The `values` array contains `[season_id, value]` pairs. Season indices
need not be contiguous, but must be unique within the entry. The value
for a stage is looked up by the stage's season.

id.description: Unique parameter identifier (int32). Must be unique across all entries.

name.description:
Unique parameter name. Must be non-empty and have no leading or
trailing whitespace.

values.description:
Array of [season_id, value] pairs. Must be non-empty. season_id values
must be unique within this entry. All values must be finite.

items.description: Season index (matches the season map in stages.json).
Finite numeric value for this season.

oneOf.description:
Computed parameter — value derived from hydro geometry at each stage.

No numeric values are supplied; the solver resolves the value from
the hydro plant's geometry and the study's reference operating point.
The `computed_spec` object names which quantity to derive and from
which plant.

id.description: Unique parameter identifier (int32). Must be unique across all entries.

name.description:
Unique parameter name. Must be non-empty and have no leading or
trailing whitespace.

description:
Scalar parameters loaded from `system/scalar_parameters.json`.

Scalar parameters are named values that can be referenced by the `@name`
sigil in generic-constraint coefficient expressions. The solver resolves
each parameter to a concrete f64 value before building the LP for each stage.

Four kinds are supported:

- `constant` — one value applied to every stage.
- `per_stage` — one value per study stage, indexed from 0.
- `seasonal` — one value per season index, looked up by the stage's season.
- `computed` — derived from hydro geometry data; no numeric values supplied.

All `id` values must be unique across the array. All `name` values must be
unique, non-empty, and free of leading/trailing whitespace.

$schema.description: JSON schema URI — informational, not validated.

scalar_parameters.description:
Array of scalar parameter entries. May be empty. Each entry must have
a unique `id` and a unique `name`.
